# Remission Order (Whistle Bend Phase 68 Interest Charges)

YOIC 2024/58

*Made under the Financial Administration Act*

## PHASE 6B INTEREST CHARGES)

### Interest charges remitted

1 Interest charges accrued under the Lands Act during the

period beginning April 23, 2023 and ending

October 6, 2023, as set out in the attached Schedule, in

respect of the sale of Whistle Bend Phase 6B lots listed

in the attached Schedule are remitted.
